title: Every create, delete, move, and reassign action produces a toast with an Undo option
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser with Schedule: Delete.
2. Schedulable lines and an existing shift are available.
3. You are on the Schedule page.
custom_steps:
1. Create a shift - watch for a toast.
2. Move a shift to another day - watch for a toast.
3. Reassign a shift to another technician - watch for a toast.
4. Delete a shift - watch for a toast.
custom_expected:
1. Each of the four actions produces a toast notification.
2. Every toast offers an Undo option.
